title: Place Value: Tens and Ones to 99
seo_title: Grade 2 Place Value Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise the place value of at least two-digit numbers to 99; decompose two-digit numbers into multiples of tens and ones.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 2 maths worksheets: place value, tens and ones, breaking up two-digit numbers and comparing. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In 47, the 4 means 4 tens (40) and the 7 means 7 ones.
  • 47 = 40 + 7.
  • You can also break it up as 30 + 17.
  • Compare the tens first, then the ones.

Examples

Example

6 tens and 3 ones

60 + 3

Answer: 63

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
SwappingThe tens digit is on the left.
Adding digits4 tens 7 ones is 47, not 11.
Ones firstCompare the tens first.

items.q: 47 = 40 + ☐
items.e: 47 is 4 tens and 7 ones. The tens make 40. The ones make 7. So 47 = 40 + 7.

items.q: 43 = ☐ + 3

items.q: Which is another way to make 56?
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 40 + 16 = 56. It is still 56.
Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 60 + 15 = 75. It is still 75.

items.q: 34 = 20 + ☐
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 3 tens and 4 ones becomes 2 tens and 14 ones. So 34 = 20 + 14.

items.q: 46 = 30 + ☐
items.e: Break 1 ten into 10 ones. 4 tens and 6 ones becomes 3 tens and 16 ones. So 46 = 30 + 16.

items.q: 53 = 40 + ☐
items.e: 53 is 50 + 3. Move 1 ten from the tens to the ones: 40 + 13 = 53.
47 is 4 tens and 7 ones. 4 tens = 40. So 47 = 40 + 7.
63 is 6 tens and 3 ones. 6 tens = 60, not 6. So 63 = 60 + 3.

items.q: Which shows 72 split into tens and ones?

items.q: Which shows 38 split into tens and ones?

items.q: Which shows 56 split into tens and ones?

26 can be 1 ten and 16 ones. 10 + 16 = 26. (6 is wrong: 10 + 6 = 16.)
